\[
x=10^{62}-3\cdot10^{31}+9-27\cdot10^{-31}+81\cdot10^{-62}-\cdots
\]
Let \(I=10^{62}-3\cdot10^{31}+9\). The tail
\[
-27\cdot10^{-31}+81\cdot10^{-62}-\cdots
\]
is negative with absolute value less than \(1\), so
\[
\lfloor x\rfloor=I-1=10^{62}-3\cdot10^{31}+8.
\]
Modulo \(100\), \(10^{62}\equiv0\) and \(3\cdot10^{31}\equiv0\), so
\[
\lfloor x\rfloor\equiv 8 \pmod{100}.
\]

\[
\boxed{08}
\]
